answer: Wanting 314 seats means paying for 314 proofs at 73 POA each, and the 22922 POA is gone before the epoch opens. One zenith is a pass, one oasis is a fare, one thread is the stamp on the pass, and the stamp cannot be bought at any price. No single office can bless a forgery: the proof must survive three separate keepers. The firmest wall I know is Gem engraver book plate warrant engraved into the engravers hall, and its bricks are each book plate is a year of engraving logs in the line ledger. The panel does not trust the applicant; it trusts the record, and the record stands open.
